s: Din haholek bammidbar beshabbat ubo b' seipim: haholek bammidbar veeno yodea matay shabbat — moneh z' yamim miyyom shennatan el libbo shikchato, umeqaddesh shebii beqiddush vehabdala lezikkaron bealma, sheyyehe lo sham yom chaluq mishshear yamim, velo tishtakkach torat shabbat mimmennu. Abal muttar lelek bo apillu kamma parsaot, kede lemaher latzet min hammidbar. Veim yesh lo mimmah lehitparnes — asur lo laasot shum melaka gemura apillu besheshet yeme hachol shello ad sheyyikleh mah sheyyesh lo, mippene shekkol yom sepeq shabbat hu. Udebarim haasurim beshabbat middibre soperim — muttar laasotam bekol yeme hachol shello, mippene shekkol sepeq dibre soperim lehaqel. Abal bez' shello, kevan shechal alayv shabbat middibre soperim — asur bekol shebut, kemo yom tob sheni shehu gam ken sapeq, veasur bekol shebut mittaam zeh. Uleachar sheyyikleh kol mah sheyyesh lo — muttar lo laasot melaka etzel bene hashshayyara lehistakker kede parnasato bekol yom vayom apillu bashshebii shello, mippene piqquach nepesh. Velo yaaseh ella kede parnasa metzumtzemet sheyyukal lichyot bah oto hayyom bilbad, abal lo miyyom lachabero, apillu mishshishshi lashshebii shello, ki shemma hu oseh mishshabbat lechol, veen bezeh tzorek lepiqquach nepesh, shehare yukal laasot gam lemachar bechol. Veim yesh lo lechem leekol — eno rashshay lebashshel lo, mippene sheen bezeh piqquach nepesh:

Haya yodea minyan yom sheyyatza bo, kegon sheyyodea shehayyom yom rebii o yom chamishi litziato, abal eno yodea beezeh yom mime hashshabbat yatza — muttar lo laasot melaka kol kamma sheyyirtzeh beyom shemini litziato, shebbeyom kazeh lo yatza mibbeto, ki bevadday lo yatza beshabbat, veken beyom t"v, ukemo ken beyom k"b, veken leolam:
